API ReferenceZscaler Cellular APIAudit Data HandlingReturns all audit log based on filters
Returns all audit log based on filters
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/zcell/config/api/v1/audit/customers/:id/search

Returns all audit log based on filters

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
id
string
REQUIRED
QUERY PARAMETERS
page
int32

Possible values: >= 0

Page number (0-based)

Default value: 0
size
int32

Possible values: >= 1 and <= 100

Page size (1-100)

Default value: 10
sortBy
string

Field to sort by. Default: creationTime. Sortable fields: creationTime, auditOperationType, objectType, objectName, objectId, customerId, visibility.

Default value: creationTime
sortDir
string

ASC or DESC. Default: DESC.

Default value: DESC
APPLICATION/JSON
BODYREQUIRED

The body type of the operation request or response.

id
int64

ID of the audit entry, to retrieve a single object.

Possible values: >= 0

modifiedByUserId
string
startDate
int64

Start of the audit range (epoch time)

endDate
int64

End of the audit range (epoch time)

operationType
AuditOperationTypeEnum (string)

Possible values: [Create, Update, Delete, Export]

objectType
string
objectName
string
objectId
int64

Possible values: >= 0

visibility
AuditVisibilityEnum (string)

Possible values: [Customer, Root]

customerId
string

Customer ID filter (ROOT only); ignored for non-root tenants

Responses
​
200
400
401
403
404
500

200 OK -- wraps a paginated list of resources.

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
totalElements
int64

Total number of elements across all pages.

totalPages
int32

Total number of pages.

size
int32

Number of items per page.

content
object[]
